name: new-dependency
description: Adds nanoid (^5.1.5) to package.json `dependencies` and changes nothing else. Deliberately manifest-only: no source file imports nanoid, because fixtures are never `pnpm install`ed (tests reuse the monorepo's node_modules, where nanoid is not resolvable), and even a type-only import would fail `tsc` with TS2307. The dependency diff only needs the manifest. There is no lockfile in the fixtures, so lockfileChanged is false.

claim.title: Add nanoid as a runtime dependency

plan.title: Add nanoid as a runtime dependency
plan.intent: Transfers need short, URL-safe idempotency keys. Add nanoid as a runtime dependency now; a follow-up change will use it to generate the keys.
acceptanceCriteria: nanoid ^5 is listed under dependencies in package.json
No source or test files change

riskDeclarations.description: New third-party runtime dependency (nanoid, no install scripts, no transitive dependencies).
